profile.Name: Lady Kana
profile.Job: Owner of the slave farm at Port North
profile.Personality: Proud, cold, and businesslike about the people she owns. She calls her farm the largest in the Empire and sees no shame in how it runs.
profile.Backstory: She lives at Port North behind hooded noble guards and ships stone and building materials made by her slaves.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Speaks like a noblewoman discussing her estate, and calls slaves workers or stock.
